title: iynk project document
description: Canonical project document, schemaVersion 1.x, opSchema 1.1. Written as RFC 8785 canonical JSON. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express are in PROJECT_DATA_MODEL.md section 10 (validation passes V1 to V4). 1.1 adds the ops domain.patch, wire.set, view.set, group.set, group.remove, access.set, actor.set, actor.remove, provenance.set, dep.remove by {ref, version}; views[].groups[]; Joint.limits.effort; Body.inertia_g_mm2 and Body.com_mm; Fault.cause_id, symptom_ids and injectable; Proposal.steps and nine statuses.

revision.description: Number of ops applied since genesis. The only revision counter. Not part of the state hash (PROJECT_DATA_MODEL.md 6.4), so undo and restore can return to an earlier hash.

SchemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. This schema file is major 1, minor 1. A minor bump only adds optional fields.

SemVer.description: Pinned exactly. A newer part version never changes an old project silently (R-029).

Timestamp.description: UTC, millisecond precision, always with Z.

LocalId.description: Unique inside its parent collection only. Never used across collections.

PinId.description: A pin id exactly as declared by the component definition (component.schema.json localId).

LocalizedText.description: Inline per-locale text. Replaces the catalogue TextKey indirection. "en" is required.

Text.description: Plain string (one language, author-written) or LocalizedText.

Ext.description: Namespaced extension data. Keys are "x-name" or reverse-DNS names. Preserved verbatim by readers that do not know them. Never used for fields the core needs.

ParamValue.description: A literal, or { param: "par_x" } bound to a project parameter.

Unit.description: Same list as component.schema.json. Base units only, no prefixes.

rpy_deg.description: Roll, pitch, yaw about the fixed X, Y, Z axes of the parent frame, in degrees (URDF convention).

ParamId.description: Parameter key declared by a component definition (component.schema.json key), e.g. "ohms", "color".

keyThumbprint.description: Base64url SHA-256 of the actor public key (F-206). Absent for a purely local actor.

authority.description: The file copy is a mirror. Only a server that hosts a room enforces it.

designator.description: The label printed on the real part, e.g. "D13", "+5V".

net.description: Net name the interpreters and checks use for this pin (catalogue PinRow.net). Kept for the legacy interpreter path.

interface.description: Derived from the definition when the dependency is added. A CI test compares it with the shipped definition for builtin parts; the digest does it for library and embedded parts.

definition.description: Full part descriptor (component.schema.json). Present only when origin is "embedded" in the bare JSON form; the .iynkz container keeps it in definitions/.

keepApart.description: Catalogue ParamChip.keepApart: this number must stay below or above another parameter by at least gap.

ports.description: Verilog: top-level port to board pin ids, bit 0 first.

legs.description: Breadboard views: leg (pin id) to hole name on the surface component, e.g. { "A": "c19" }. Layout only; it never creates a connection.

route_mm.description: Absent means the renderer routes. The document never stores an empty array (wire.route with [] clears it).

surface.description: Breadboard views: the breadboard component whose holes and strips this view uses.

inertia_g_mm2.description: Principal moments of inertia [Ixx, Iyy, Izz] in g*mm^2 about the centre of mass. Absent: derived from shape and mass_g. Must satisfy the triangle inequality (RB-E-INERTIA).

com_mm.description: Centre of mass offset from the body frame origin, in mm. Absent: the shape centre.

min.description: Lower bound. Units follow Joint.kind: revolute, continuous and wheel use degrees; prismatic uses millimetres. fixed has no limits.

max.description: Upper bound. Same units as min.

effort.description: Peak actuator effort. revolute, continuous and wheel: N*m. prismatic: N.

velocity.description: Peak speed. revolute, continuous and wheel: degrees per second. prismatic: millimetres per second.

effort_n.description: Deprecated alias of effort, accepted for one release (A-8). A writer emits effort; a limits object with both is invalid (V3-LIMITS).

Joint.description: Limits units follow kind (see Joint.limits). A fixed joint carries no limits.

Mechanical.description: Frame "world" is implicit: right-handed, +x forward, +y left, +z up, millimetres, degrees. Mass in grams, as in component.schema.json.

path.description: Relative POSIX path, NFC, no "." or ".." segment, unique ignoring case.

spdx.description: SPDX identifier or "LicenseRef-...". D-017: until Amar decides, new projects carry "LicenseRef-iynk-pending" (one placeholder, the same string as component.schema.json and openapi.yaml). "LicenseRef-local-private" is only for parts in the local library, never a project licence.

path.description: Relative POSIX path, NFC, no "." or ".." segment, unique ignoring case.

RegistryId.description: Open registry id, e.g. "iynk-interp", "avr8js", "iynk-mna", "rapier". Not an enum, so a spike result never forces a schema change.

oneOf.description: New in 1.0: behaviour by device-registry reference (F-097, F-208), e.g. "bme280".

pins.description: Board pins the device drives, in the device order. Optional once the orchestrator derives them from the netlist (F-047).

t.description: Milliseconds of virtual time (catalogue name kept so checks stay reusable).

cause_id.description: D-010 cause_id; same pattern as component.schema.json.

symptom_ids.description: D-010 symptom_id list. May be empty for a fault the person made up.

kind.description: Project fault kind. Mapping from a part's injectable_faults[].kind is in PROJECT_DATA_MODEL.md 5.11.

id.description: The id of the entry in that part's injectable_faults.

injectable.description: Set when the fault was made from a part's declared injectable fault. With the library present, V6-FAULT-DRIFT warns when it does not resolve or the copied fields differ.

StateCond.description: Catalogue StateCond, unchanged (legacy figure state; used by migrated labs only).

Check.description: Catalogue Check kinds unchanged (label becomes Text; id and visibility added), plus node-voltage and supply-current.

script.description: Replaces simulation.world.script for this test when present.

faults.description: Fault ids enabled for this test. Absent means each fault keeps its own enabled flag.

variants.description: Board variants this lesson applies to; boards[0].variant is the first.

template.description: Starter code with {{p:<parameter name>}} tokens. The source file holds the rendered default; Reset re-renders this.

assembly.description: Catalogue BuildStep list, kept as data for the legacy figure until the Studio renderer replaces it.

thirdParty.description: Content that came from somewhere else (D-017, F-197). Only provenance.set changes review.

Op.description: One validated, invertible change. The pure function apply(state, op) -> { state, inverse } | { reject: code } is the only way the document changes.

oneOf.description: Owner, or author.kind system for a server-validated request.

set.description: RFC 7396 merge patch for board fields (label, variant, powerInput, refdes): a null value removes the key.

params.description: RFC 7396 merge patch for params: a null value removes the key.

set.description: RFC 7396 merge patch for component fields (label, refdes, locked): a null value removes the key.

params.description: RFC 7396 merge patch for params: a null value removes the key.

route_mm.description: An empty array clears the route (the field becomes absent).

path.description: Relative POSIX path, NFC, no "." or ".." segment, unique ignoring case.

thirdParty.description: Content that came from somewhere else (D-017, F-197). Only provenance.set changes review.

value.description: Import and migration only. Editors use domain.patch.

patch.description: RFC 7396 merge patch applied to domains.<domain>.data. A null value removes a key; nulls exist in ops, never in the document.

seq.description: Revision after this op. Assigned by the ordering authority (the room server, or the local counter when working alone).

base.description: Revision the author saw when making the op.

model.description: Model name when kind is ai.

status.description: Lifecycle of AI_ARCHITECTURE 7.3. draft: being built; invalid: failed the dry run; open: waiting for a person; accepted/partial/rejected: decided; stale: the project moved under it; superseded: replaced by a re-proposal; expired: session ended under retention.

contextHash.description: sha256 of the context pack the model saw.

steps.description: Ordered steps; each step is applied as one batch and 'accept some' selects whole steps (AI_ARCHITECTURE 7.4). At most 12 steps and 40 ops per step. The 120-op total and 32 KiB limits of the AI host are checked by the host, not by this schema.

Proposal.description: Kept outside the document (room or local store). Never written to the document directly; an accepted proposal becomes ops with author.proposal set.

baseChain.description: Hash-chain value at baseRevision. Head chain = fold over ops: sha256(prev + canonical(envelope)). Genesis: sha256("iynk.chain.v1:" + project id).

Domains.description: Domain data owned by the robotics and drone specs. The envelope is validated here; data is validated by robotics.domain.schema.json and drone.domain.schema.json (one schema per major version, so schemaVersion 1.x selects them; a minor bump only adds optional fields). Both files must be loaded by the validator (tools/validate-project.mjs does this).

hash.description: State hash of "project" (PROJECT_DATA_MODEL.md section 6.4). A mismatch on open is a warning, not a refusal (R-037).

FileEnvelope.description: The .iynk single-file form (R-037). The .iynkz container holds this file plus assets.

items.description: The c of a placement, or the id of a wire, junction or label of the same view.

Group.description: A set of drawn things that moves, locks and copies as one. No electrical meaning, never changes a net (rule G1). A member is in at most one group and groups do not nest (V3-GROUP).
